title: Two hospitalized after stabbing in Syracuse; both expected to survive
summary: Two individuals (a 15-year-old boy and 41-year-old man) were stabbed on Tioga Street in Syracuse on September 6, 2026 at approximately 8:27 p.m. Both victims are hospitalized and expected to survive. This incident represents a violent crime requiring police response and potential follow-up investigation.
